name: Bring Her Home
source: Amelia has been able to see monsters that nobody else can see for thirteen years. Though she has grown accustomed to their presence, she still tries to protect her younger sister from them. When Amelia fails to keep her safe, an ordinary day turns into a desperate attempt to bring her home.
